# Repository Assets

Place sample screenshots, demo GIFs, and application banners in this directory for inclusion in `README.md`.

### Recommended Naming Convention:
- `banner.png` (Main GitHub project banner / header image)
- `demo.gif` (Action capture & flipbook animation)
- `screenshot_camera.png` (Camera preview & controls screen)
- `screenshot_result.png` (Step 1 gallery & compositing result)

### Embedding in Markdown:
```markdown
![MotionShot Demo](.github/assets/demo.gif)
```
